note: iPhone Duo launches in Apple stores this Friday, and the Patriots play the Bears tonight on Thursday Night Football.

front.title: iPhone Duo Review Roundup: Great Hinge, Messy Apps, and Everybody Misses Face ID
front.tldr: Reviews of Apple's iPhone Duo, out before Friday's launch, highlight a well-engineered hinge alongside inconsistent app support and widespread complaints about losing Face ID.

front.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet, a Proactive AI Agent
front.tldr: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a proactive agent that works across connected apps without being asked, following Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots into the same space.

front.title: Kimi Antonelli could be crowned Formula 1 world champion this weekend
front.tldr: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli heads into this weekend's United States Grand Prix with a chance to clinch the Formula 1 title, while still washing his own car by hand.

stories.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
stories.tldr: Meta says its Muse AI app has passed 10 million users, with shopping and personal productivity among the most common uses, the company said at Q3 earnings.

stories.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
stories.tldr: Startup Recursive released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model it says was built largely by its own AI research system, an early test of self-improving AI.

stories.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
stories.tldr: As Amazon blocks AI shopping agents, Walmart is doing the opposite, rolling out technology that lets agents buy on customers' behalf with spending controls.

stories.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
stories.tldr: Blacksmith, whose platform helps companies build and test AI code, raised a $66 million Series C led by Sequoia, valuing the company at $1 billion.

stories.title: Tesla says it will start selling Cybercabs by end of year
stories.tldr: Tesla said it will start selling its Cybercab to customers by the end of the year, even as regulators investigate whether the vehicle meets safety standards.

stories.title: Sony's PlayStation Pulse headset arrives on November 19 for $100
stories.tldr: Sony's new PlayStation Pulse headset launches on 19 November for $100, with pre-orders opening on 29 October.

stories.title: GM is betting compute and AI will help it compete with Chinese automakers
stories.tldr: GM's fourth-generation EV platform will add a new central computer and AI-driven electrical architecture, debuting in 2028 on the Cadillac line, as it looks to compete with Chinese rivals.

stories.title: Xbox is previewing paid cloud gaming for players without Game Pass
stories.tldr: Microsoft is previewing a paid cloud gaming option for Xbox players who don't subscribe to Game Pass, alongside new rate limits.

stories.title: The iPhone Duo
stories.tldr: John Gruber's review says the iPhone Duo feels like 'an extraordinarily polished prototype' rather than a finished product he'd want to buy, after a week of use.

stories.title: Apple must open iPhone to alternative app stores in Australia after Epic Games ruling
stories.tldr: An Australian federal judge has ordered Apple to open the iPhone to alternative app stores following its long antitrust battle with Epic Games. Apple plans to appeal.

stories.title: iOS 27.2 reveals Apple's Messages app could soon get highly requested change
stories.tldr: Code in next week's iOS 27.2 points to a long-requested Messages change: the ability to exclude muted conversations from the unread badge count.

stories.title: What 32,000 Folds Did to the iPhone Duo's Hinge
stories.tldr: Joanna Stern put more than 32,000 folds on her iPhone Duo review unit over four nights to stress-test the hinge, a test Apple itself hasn't published.

stories.title: Mark Kermode and Daphne Dentz on restoring Ken Russell's The Devils
stories.tldr: Critic Mark Kermode and restorer Daphne Dentz discuss piecing together a definitive version of Ken Russell's 1971 film The Devils, more than 20 years after Kermode first tried.

stories.title: Clayface review: DC horror film is good, gross fun with no franchise homework required
stories.tldr: Variety's review calls Clayface a gross, fun body-horror entry in the DC Universe that doesn't require knowledge of the wider franchise to enjoy.

stories.title: Tom Cruise to Be Honored With AFI Life Achievement Award in 2027
stories.tldr: Tom Cruise will receive the 52nd AFI Life Achievement Award at a gala in Hollywood on 24 April 2027, the American Film Institute announced.

stories.title: Cory Michael Smith joins Scarlett Johansson in Scapegoat at Square Peg and A24
stories.tldr: Cory Michael Smith has joined the ensemble cast of Ari Aster's thriller Scapegoat, starring Scarlett Johansson alongside Jacob Elordi, Jude Law and Ella Purnell.

stories.title: Celtics fall apart in season opener, lose to Pistons despite big Paul George debut
stories.tldr: The Celtics gave up a 20-0 fourth-quarter run and lost their season opener to the Pistons, despite a big debut from new signing Paul George.

stories.title: 3 matchups that will decide Patriots vs. Bears
stories.tldr: The Patriots will need to contain Chicago's run game and limit the Bears' clock control to win Thursday night's Week 7 matchup, Boston.com says.

stories.title: Patriots to start Walter Rouse, Matt Pryor at guard against Bears
stories.tldr: New England will be without both starting guards for Thursday's game against the Bears, with Walter Rouse and Matt Pryor stepping in at the position.

stories.title: Lando Norris risks unwanted F1 record as disastrous title defence continues
stories.tldr: Reigning champion Lando Norris is on course for one of the worst title defences in Formula 1 history, a year after winning his first championship.

stories.title: FIA set to close F1 cost cap loophole with new rules
stories.tldr: The FIA's World Motor Sport Council has approved new rules stopping teams' non-F1 staff from working on Formula 1 projects, closing a cost cap loophole.

stories.title: Red Sox reportedly make two changes on Chad Tracy's coaching staff
stories.tldr: The Red Sox have reportedly made two more changes to Chad Tracy's coaching staff, months after overhauling it following Alex Cora's firing.

read.why: With Apple and Anthropic both shipping big product bets this week, a look at how Shopify plans, organises and ships product is a useful companion for a product marketer.
read.title: How Shopify builds product
read.subtitle: VP of Product Glen Coates on how Shopify plans around yearly themes, organizes around jobs to be done, tracks using a homegrown tool, why they shifted away from a GM structure, and much more

listen.why: Tesla's Cybercab sales push and Optimus production ramp make this a timely look at how Elon Musk thinks.
listen.title: #415 How Elon Thinks

listen.why: A builder's story of turning a protein bar into a category leader, useful craft for any product marketer.
listen.title: Building One of the Fastest Growing CPG Companies in History | Peter Rahal of David Protein, Medici Brands & RXBAR

listen.why: With Anthropic and Apple both making big product bets this week, Ballmer's view from inside Microsoft's biggest calls is a good companion.
listen.title: The Steve Ballmer Interview

finally.title: A New Wildlife Crossing in Colorado Has Already Cut Vehicle Collisions by 91 Percent
finally.tldr: Colorado's new wildlife-only highway bridge, the largest of its kind in North America, has already cut vehicle collisions with animals by 91 percent since opening in December 2025.
